evidence: Failing-before run: `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py -q -k needs` with the model change stashed gave 4 failed, 1 passed. The 4 failures were AttributeErrors for record_type and task_id. The same command after the change gave 5 passed. The full run `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q` gave 175 passed.
observations: In /home/ayin/se-workflow/.claude/worktrees/needs-you-records/scripts/dashboard_model.py, NeedsYouItem has three new fields: record_type, body and task_id. Each defaults to "", so the old four-argument constructor still works. text is unchanged and stays untruncated; only the app clips it. A new helper, _task_for, finds task_id: it picks the work-item in the same effort whose subject equals the item subject or is a prefix of it at a "-" boundary, and takes the longest match. task_id is "" when nothing matches, so an effort-level question gets no link. For unsigned checks the match uses the acceptance subject. _needs_you takes a new optional tasks argument, and load_snapshot passes it the effort's work-items. I did not add a goal-complete item. I did not edit dashboard_app.py.
Body loading: a plain `adaptive-artifacts list` returns only `body_excerpt`, which is the first line; `list --full` returns the full `body`. I chose to load bodies in the snapshot. A new FULL_TYPES tuple makes `_list` add `--full` for continuity-question, finding and check-run only. This changes the shared `_list` helper by one line, outside the needs-you code, so check it when you merge with finished-effort-view. Cost: check-runs are now listed in full on each refresh, and the check-run list grows with history. If that gets slow, drop check-run from FULL_TYPES and let the detail screen `get` the body lazily.
Tests added in tests/test_dashboard_model.py: test_needs_you_items_carry_record_type_and_full_body, test_needs_you_items_link_to_the_task_with_the_longest_matching_slug (covers exact match, prefix, no "-" boundary, shorter prefix, unsigned check through its acceptance, and a same-slug task in another effort), test_needs_you_effort_level_question_links_to_no_task, and test_needs_you_item_defaults_keep_the_four_field_constructor_working.
